spans.s:
लिकुच m. (-चः) A sort of bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E.
लकुच q. v., and इ substituted for the first vowel.
लिक्का f. (-क्का) A nit, a young louse. E. It is a various reading of लिक्षा. “निकि” ।
लीक्का f. (-क्का) A nit: see लिक्का ।

लिक्षा f. (-क्षा)
 1. A nit, a young louse, or the egg of a louse.
 2. A
poppy seed considered as a measure of weight, or one sixth of a
mustard seed.
 E. लक्ष् to mark, aff. घञ्, इ substituted for the radical
vowel and the deriv. irr.: also क्क being substituted for the final
लिक्का, and with कन् added, fem. form, लिक्षिका; again with ई
substituted for the radical vowel लीक्षा, &c.; also read लिख्या ।
लीक्षा f. (-क्षा) A nit: see लिक्षा ।
